findings.reason: The helper gates audit status/counts/replay modes and frozen-ledger partial status, but does not read or gate the measured audit wrapper, actual static/browser reports, separate four-image manual report, exact Lean version, or audit/manifest/selection proof identities before making their README statements. The existing separate manual report supports the bounded rendering sentence; the composite browser report does not itself claim a new manual pass.

The helper writes progress.json before it reads the selection content-binding file needed by README generation. A missing or malformed binding can produce a reversible but incomplete metadata update. Read and validate every prerequisite before backups/writes in a new version.
